events.title: Remembering Woodstock '69
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place on this day in 1969, a pivotal moment in music history

angles.name: Woodstock '69
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since the iconic Woodstock Festival, where legendary acts like Jimi Hendrix and The Who took to the stage, let's look back at some of the performances that defined a generation

events.title: Elvis Presley: 43 Years Gone

angles.name: Elvis Remembered
angles.copy: Elvis Presley may have left the building 43 years ago, but his music lives on, we're celebrating the King's legacy with some of his biggest hits
